title: Generate a project map from canonical records
summary: Turn a pinned idea and feature catalog into an offline map with category pages, record details, and directed idea and feature relationships. Use the working Veraphify example as an adopter reference.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Gives both Ideas and Features category views.
Exposes connected and isolated records from the same source.
risks: An adopter preview can be mistaken for a version shipped by Provenistem.
Generated output can drift from source records.

evidence.claim: Veraphify documents a working adopter-side map.
